items.title: How to Check Your Mac's Manufacture Date in macOS 27
items.snippet: If you installed macOS 27 Golden Gate, here's a way to find out when your Mac was manufactured. Apple has restored access to information that effectively disappeared when it randomized its serial numbers a few years ago. On your Mac, go to System Settings ➝ General ➝ About , then click "Regulatory Certification" under the System Report button. The certificate will show with a new "Date of Manufacture" field at the bottom. You used to be able to decode the serial number on an Apple device to find out when and where it was made. I’m not a pro photographer, and if you want battery tests or performance benchmarks, my colleague Chance’s iPhone 18 Pro review has you covered. Anyone with an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 should install it immediately. Owners of the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 began reporting sudden, unexplained restarts shortly after the new wearables launched last Friday. Online reports of the problem were widespread, so it appears to have affected a large percentage of the new devices, though certainly not all.
